hero.title: Requirements governance the way your team works.
hero.subtitle: For people who run projects on their own, for small teams, and for organizations that demand control over where their data lives.

self.title: Self-service subscription
self.text: Create your account, open your first project and pay monthly without talking to anyone. Every feature in a single plan.

enterprise.title: Tailored deployment
enterprise.text: Choose where the platform runs, how people sign in and how the contract is shaped. Our team walks the evaluation with you.

deployment.title: Where the platform can run
deployment.subtitle: The same product, three deployment models.

items.title: Managed SaaS
items.text: We operate the platform for you. Fast start, no infrastructure on your side.

items.title: Dedicated instance
items.text: Application and database isolated for your organization, operated by us under contract.

items.title: On-premise
items.text: Everything in your environment — application, database and access — under an annual license. No data leaves your network.

items.title: Role-based access
items.text: Admin, manager, consultant and client, with distinct permissions per project.

items.title: Audit trail
items.text: Field-by-field history of every requirement, with the ability to roll changes back.

items.title: Validation before advancing
items.text: Circular dependencies, conflicting requirements, orphan requirements and evidence are checked in the flow.

items.title: Process maps (BPMN)
items.text: Processes linked to requirements and publishable as a portal for people who do not use the tool.

items.title: Export
items.text: Documents and spreadsheets in the format your sponsor and client expect to read.

sap.title: Built for complex integration projects — including SAP.
sap.text: The method does not depend on a technology, but the tool ships with features ready for SAP implementations, where one requirement almost always touches more than one module.
items: Cross-module matrix (ISU, CRM, FICA, Device Management, SD, MM, PM)
Business process document (BPD) for S/4HANA Utilities projects
Configurable integration types and timing (BAPI, IDoc, file, API, batch)
Lists and terminology adjustable per project
sap.disclaimer: SAP, S/4HANA and other brands mentioned belong to their respective owners. Ancoro is an independent product and is not affiliated with SAP SE.
